# Module Model

## Purpose

Define what `module` means project-wide.

## Universal module invariant

State the invariant every module must satisfy.

## Public and private boundary

Define the universal public-API/private-implementation contract and local `module.md` responsibility.

## Dependency rules

Define permitted collaboration and forbidden private implementation/persistence dependencies.

## Construct classification

Distinguish modules from compositions, interfaces, integrations, runtime, contracts, and shared foundation without documenting current construct inventories.

## Module admission

Define the evidence required before accepting a new module classification.
